title: Total items
prompt: Return the total amount of everything in the inventory. {"bolt": 3, "gear": 1} totals 4.
hints: Add each value to a running total.

docs.name: for key in data:
docs.what: Runs once per key; data[key] gives its value.

docs.name: data[key]
docs.what: The value stored under key. Assigning to it changes or adds the entry.
